Welcome onboard.

Your hostel, but easier. One operating system for everyday university life.

Hey,

Hostel life shouldn't mean expensive tiffin, a laundry guy who disappears, a dusty trunk with nowhere to go, and five WhatsApp groups that never reply.

Unimade is the student-only app that puts cheaper food, laundry, and storage next to cleaning, repairs, campus doctor bookings, internships scraped to your interests, and a community channel that actually belongs to campus.

Hostel essentials

Tiffin

Campus-priced meals from verified providers. Book once. Eat without the vendor roulette.

Laundry

Pickup, wash, fold, back to your block. Track it like any other order.

Storage

Holiday trunks, extra bags, semester overflow — short-term storage that actually exists.

Cleaning and repairs

Room clean, leaky tap, broken latch. Student-friendly partners, not a mystery uncle.

Doctor appointments

Book campus doctors without hunting a notice-board number at 11pm.

One booking system

Verified short-term providers. Simple booking and delivery through one app.

Internships, scoured for you

Tell us what you care about. Unimade crawls the internet for roles that match your interests — not a generic job dump, not last year's placement PDF.

Community channel

A student-only network — not the entire internet.

Ask for a vendor rec, split a storage run, or find someone else who arrived last week and still can't find the mess hall.

Do this next · two minutes

  1. Confirm you're a student — that's how we keep this network campus-only.
  2. Set your hostel / PG and city so tiffin, laundry, and storage show up for your block.
  3. Pick a few interests. Internship matches get sharper from day one.
  4. Place a first order, or just lurk in community. Both count.
Open Unimade and finish setup

Takes less time than waiting for the mess line to move.
Straight on price. Service fee ₹50 / order · delivery ₹30 / order · partner commission stays on the vendor side. Unimade+ is ₹199 / month if you want the essentials on autopilot.

Local vendors, laundry shops, tiffin uncles, word of mouth — they still exist. Unimade is the layer that makes them bookable, trackable, and student-verified.
